svg.text: Two ways to rank the same features
The picture this code drew: the same model, ranked two ways
The forest’s own count, made while it trained.
Shuffle and see, on the hidden test songs.
tempo tops one, danceability the other. Trust the shuffle:
it is measured on songs the model never saw.
